title: Amplify an acquired rank-two reset using its certified scalar contraction
statement: On the same calibration confidence event, eta=(actual residual+2w)/g_lower bounds |d_S|. Independent private repetitions S^k have epsilon_k=min(1,eta^k/g_lower) relative to the new target S^k(rho0). Choosing k from calibration data needs no new calibration union.

requires: fresh private key for each copy
assumptions: k fixed before executing that reset/evaluation block
same controlled interface and private records
costs: k independent random keys and record handling
k>1 not executed in the saved source experiment
contract.units: TV and dimensionless scalar slope; physical time/actions separate
contract.obstruction: Reuses an acquired contraction, but cannot reuse the k=1 target probabilities or ignore per-use actuation cost.

evidence.quote: There is no repeated model-estimation error to add.

review.scope: Exact source-supported extraction only; any scoped substantive acceptance is a separate version-bound review overlay.
